experience.company: NASA Human Research Program, NeuroErgo Lab, UW–Madison
experience.title: Undergraduate Research Scholar — Manuscript in Preparation for Publication
experience.description: First-authored spaceflight fatigue study (N=48) addressing NASA HRR SM-104, BMed-108 & Sleep-101. Trained LOSO 1D-CNN on raw Tobii wearable streams for 3-class fatigue detection across N=48. Outperformed PERCLOS benchmark across 3-class fatigue states via LOSO cross-validation. Built multimodal PPG + pupillometry fusion model for offline spaceflight fatigue inference. Preparing release of de-identified N=48 multimodal dataset (3 stressor conditions) to NASA Open Data Portal.

projects.name: AutoAnatomy
projects.description: Open-source CLI tool wrapping nnU-Net for 7-class craniofacial CT segmentation at 0.5mm isotropic resolution. Implemented DICOM-to-STL export pipeline; reduced manual 3D Slicer segmentation from hours to minutes per scan. Adopted by Oestro Engineering Lab for RSFS v3.0 surgical planning pipeline; received lab award.

projects.name: EvalFrame
projects.description: Modular LLM evaluation harness supporting Claude and GPT model families across 5 task types. Logged prompt versions and scoring metrics in MLflow for reproducible benchmarking. Deployed on Google Cloud Run via Docker; processed 500+ eval cases per run with automated scoring.

projects.name: CourseIQ
projects.description: Trained grade outcome classifier on 5,600+ UW–Madison courses using Madgrades GPA and RMP data. Classified multiclass grades via XGBoost in MLflow, achieving 78% accuracy against a 61% baseline. Containerized with Docker; versioned datasets in GCS with automated scheduled refresh.

projects.name: TapMap
projects.description: Web app mapping Madison addresses to serving wells with live GeoJSON service zone overlays. Developed custom WaterScore algorithm to quantify water quality risk by service zone and well source. Integrated Google Places, Flask APIs, and GeoJSON layers for precise location-specific well attribution.
